items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: In the Metronome All Stars with Diz and Miles and Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: I’ve got to go to a wedding. I’ll put my tie on. I’m sorry I don’t put a tie on.
No, you’re fine, believe me. In the Metronome All Stars with Diz and Miles and Charlie Parker.

Well Charlie was sort of nice to me. Miles was funny with me. Dizzy was all right. I mean he talked to me. And Charlie was very good too. I mean if we were walking, I’d be in another place, across the street on 52nd Street, and he used to walk around with this horn and just sit in every night. He’d walk around with her in the summertime. He’d walk in and play a couple of choruses and walk out and go to the next. place Well heard me playing all the time you know, so I was very surprised, I don’t know, like I said…
